name: 玄剑录
english_description: Part of the ES II / Xiake Xing ("Wandering Blade") engine family, sharing lineage with titles such as "Xiake Xing 2001," but with its own independent wuxia world and storyline centered on sects and locations including the Ming Cult, Kunlun, and Xiake Island. Its files carry a "Cracked by Kafei" header, placing it in the same release batch as xkx2000zxb (a separate archive, xkx2001, circulated under a different "Cracked by Roath" release).
